//: Emulator-only config that binds to every interface, so the test iPhone can reach the emulator over the LAN. The default firebase.json binds 127.0.0.1, which a device cannot route to. Used as `firebase emulators:start --config firebase.emulator-lan.json`. It has to live here rather than under ios-native/ because the CLI refuses paths outside the project directory. Never used for deploys: no hosting block, and the emulator is the only thing it configures.
